chosen_reason: Of the PT-MU* fleet, PT-MUG has the two best free-licence photographs in the CURRENT LATAM livery and both are port-side and near-orthographic: a 6000x4000 in-flight side view against clean sky (Frankfurt 2022) and a 5172x2909 ground side view at London Heathrow (2025). Together they gave the fin sash twice, independently, agreeing within 0.2-0.4 m. Sister ships PT-MUC and PT-MUB cover the starboard side and the nose close-up.

aircraft.engines: 2x GE90-115B (the only engine offered on the 777-300ER)
aircraft.gear: six-wheel main bogies (three axles), rear axle steering — the 777 signature
